description_en: Queries the relationships between resources within the management account or members of your resource directory
description_zh: 查询资源目录管理账号和多个成员中的资源关系
kebab_example: aliyun resourcecenter list-multi-account-resource-relationships --scope rd-r40000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ACS::ACK::Cluster --resource-id m-eb3hji0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMultiAccountResourceRelationships

parameters.help_en:
The search scope. Valid values:

ID of a resource directory: Resources within the management account and all members of the resource directory are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html operation to query the ID.
ID of the Root folder: Resources within all members in the Root folder and the subfolders of the Root folder are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html operation to query the ID.
ID of a folder: Resources within all members in the folder are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html operation to query the ID.
ID of a member: Resources within the member are searched. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的账号范围。取值： 
资源目录ID，表示搜索管理账号和所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html。
Root资源夹ID，表示搜索Root资源夹及子资源夹下的所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html。
资源夹ID，表示搜索指定资源夹下所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html。
成员ID，表示搜索指定成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
